description: This file is a migration script for a PHP-based HRM system (OrangeHRM), specifically for version 5.0.0. It contains PHP class code that defines database schema changes, data manipulations, and configuration updates necessary for migrating this particular version of the system.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A PHP class extending AbstractMigration, responsible for performing database schema updates, data modifications, and configuration setups necessary for upgrading to system version 5.0.0 in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration operations such as schema modifications, data insertions, updates, and configuration settings related to the 5.0.0 upgrade.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '5.0' representing the target migration version.

methods.name: configureTimeMenuItemsIfTimesheetStartDateDefined
methods.description: Enables or disables Time-related menu items based on the presence of a timesheet start date configuration.

methods.name: configureLeaveMenuItemsIfLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Enables or disables Leave-related menu items based on the presence of a leave period configuration.

methods.name: configureMenuItems
methods.description: Helper method to set menu item statuses based on configuration values and parent menu titles.

methods.name: addTimezoneColumnsToAttendanceRecord
methods.description: Adds timezone-related columns to attendance records and updates their values based on predefined timezone mappings.

methods.name: updateMenuConfigurator
methods.description: Updates the menu configurator class for a specified module and screen URL.

methods.name: updateModuleDisplayNames
methods.description: Updates display names for various modules in the system.

methods.name: insertI18nGroups
methods.description: Inserts internationalization groups into the system for specific features like attendance, help, and auth.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of LangStringHelper for language string operations.

methods.name: getTranslationHelper
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of TranslationHelper for handling translations.

methods.name: cleanUniqueIdTable
methods.description: Deletes non-relevant records from the unique ID table, cleaning it for the new system setup.

methods.name: hideAddonMenuItems
methods.description: Hides specific addon menu items such as 'Claim' and 'LDAP Configuration' by setting their status to false.
